infoAside.title: Recording bot
infoAside.identityBody: One bot for this Amber Coffer install, for all campaigns. It is your presence as Master on the server: the name you choose. Another computer needs another bot.
infoAside.whyBody: Creating the bot is your choice. Invite it only on servers where you may record, and tell your group if needed. The token is secret — do not share it; anyone with it acts as your bot. If it leaks, regenerate it in the portal. Amber Coffer does not listen to players on our servers; audio goes through your bot on your Discord.
infoAside.step1: Open the Developer Portal (button on the left) with your Discord account.
infoAside.step2: Create a new application and give it a name players will recognize (e.g. Narrator).
infoAside.step3: Open the Bot tab and add the bot if Discord asks.
infoAside.step4: Copy the token, paste it on the left, and save. Do not send it to anyone.
infoAside.step5: For voice-only recording you usually do not need to change anything else on the Bot tab.
infoAside.wizardNote: Then save the token if needed and connect server and voice channel on the Campaign page in the Vault.

botSetup.title: Recording bot (this device)
botSetup.hint: Create your own Discord bot once; the token stays on this computer and is never synced.
botSetup.stepCreate: New Application → choose a name → open the Bot tab.
botSetup.stepBotToken: Reset Token (or View Token) → copy → paste below → Save token.
botSetup.stepIntents: On the Bot tab, enable privileged intents only if Discord asks; voice-only recording usually needs no extra intents.

liveSession.discordSetupAlertWhyTitle: WHY you need your own bot
liveSession.discordSetupAlertWhy: Amber Coffer records session audio from your Discord voice channel using a bot you control. We do not use a single shared project bot because the token grants access to your server (it stays on this computer only, never synced), each campaign has its own voice channel, and Discord permissions differ per server. You stay in control of your data and your server.
liveSession.discordSetupAlertStep1: 1. Open https://discord.com/developers/applications and sign in with your Discord account.
liveSession.discordSetupAlertStep2: 2. Click "New Application", choose a name (e.g. "Campaign bot"), and confirm.
liveSession.discordSetupAlertStep3: 3. Open the "Bot" tab → "Reset Token" (or "View Token") → copy the token → paste it above and click "Save token". Never share it.
liveSession.discordSetupAlertStep4: 4. Still under "Bot", enable any privileged intents Discord requires (for voice-only recording you usually do not need "Message Content").
liveSession.discordSetupAlertStep5: 5. Open the "OAuth2" tab → "URL Generator": scope "bot", permissions "Connect" and "Use Voice Activity" (optional "Speak") → copy the URL → open it in your browser and invite the bot to your campaign server.
liveSession.discordSetupAlertStep6: 6. In Discord (desktop or web): User Settings → "Advanced" → enable "Developer Mode". Right-click your session voice channel → "Copy Channel ID" → paste it above and click "Save channel".
liveSession.discordSetupAlertStep7: 7. When you start recording, the bot joins that channel and saves one audio track per participant for offline transcription.
